parameters.name: Email
parameters.description: The new email address of the notification recipient.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the bastion host instance.
> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host instance ID.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The new name of the notification recipient. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, cannot start with a special character, and can contain only the following special characters: periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), backslashes (\), and spaces.
> If this parameter is not specified, the name remains unchanged.

parameters.name: Phone
parameters.description: The new phone number of the notification recipient.

parameters.name: ReceiverId
parameters.description:
The ID of the notification recipient.
> You can call the ListProjectNotifyReceivers operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
